summary: White County Schools urges the Commission to reject any proposal that would terminate or limit the E-Rate Program and recommends maintaining full Category 1 broadband support for rural districts, protecting Category 2 support for managed internal broadband services, making cybersecurity and threat mitigation permanently eligible, and rejecting proposals to narrow program scope based on high adoption rates.

claims.requested_action: Maintain full E-Rate funding and eligibility
claims.argument: Without sustained funding, rural districts cannot absorb recurring annual circuit costs
claims.evidence_quote: Without sustained Category 1 funding, rural districts cannot absorb recurring annual circuit costs.
